objective: Proof by certificates checked with independent code: the periodic parent tiling found by CRYSTAL-UP-20261108-001A-E002 (20 tiles per period) cuts into a periodic plane obeying the labelled law of s = 10101 / 00110, and with labels exchanged that of its relabelling 11001 / 01010; with one exported escape per class of ONE-BIT-20261108-001B and its relabelling, every one of the sixteen one-bit decorations that ROUND-PRICE-20261108-001's exact census left open has a periodic plane obeying its law.
